name: model
description: Manage local AI models via Ollama: list, pull, remove, update, benchmark, plus the legacy `ollama` command tree.
author: nself

actions.pull: Pull (download) a model from the Ollama registry
actions.remove: Delete a pulled model to free disk space
actions.update: Re-pull a model to pick up the latest tag
actions.benchmark: Run a standard prompt and report tokens/s + p99 latency

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables. It is a thin HTTP client to whatever Ollama-compatible endpoint NSELF_OLLAMA_HOST/PLUGIN_AI_OLLAMA_URL resolve to. Includes the `ollama` subcommand tree (cli/cmd/commands/ollama.go), which was already a child of `model`, not a separate top-level command, since CLI-R09's legacy-spelling rewrite (cmd/commands/legacy_spellings.go: "ollama" -> ["model","ollama"]) turned bare `nself ollama` into `nself model ollama` before this extraction. That rewrite is unaffected by this move: it fires in core before the plugin-proxy check, producing argv ["model","ollama",...], which core now proxies to nself-model since "model" is no longer a registered core command. Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/model*.go and ollama*.go under CLI-R11; zero internal/* imports in the originals, so this is a verbatim move, not an adaptation.
